scope: Week 11: 13 of 13 events have captured player prices, all 13 across all six standard categories. Nov. 22 5:31-5:32 PM CT round refreshed two strictly future events only, MIN-SF and CIN-WSH. Actual prices and times are per event and row; Illinois only, not continuous or full-slate current coverage.
availability_note: Book listing and roster membership are not game clearance. Model figures retain their own older source times and have no new injury/workload adjustment. Book prices are comparisons only; no betting edge or current TN offer claimed.
